hypothesis: Single-name stops still permit repeated correlated losses. Keep an independently simulated unrestricted trend book as an observable risk reference; use its peak loss, daily loss and fresh recovery to control the actual cash book. The reference continues while actual capital is in cash, preventing realized-equity recovery deadlock.

base_policy.selection: Chosen exclusively by the already frozen training objective ending 2025-12-31; not by the 2026 result

fixed_rules.risk_cut: after close, shadow peak drawdown reaches loss OR one-session shadow loss >=4%; next-open cash reduction
fixed_rules.recovery: shadow NAV above causal exponential mean(span), at least rebound above cash-state trough, and positive one-session shadow return
fixed_rules.identity: Shadow NAV and its targets use only observations through the signal date; prefix invariance required; no reset of reported actual NAV or reported drawdown

selection_objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
execution: Same cash-only next-open engine, costs, dates, capital and data. Risk exits cannot be re-labelled earlier than their actual signal/fill dates.
